Container.Name: dptv-web
Container.Overview: DPTV Web - watch Live TV and browse the TV guide in a browser, signed in to DPTV-Server with an XC login. Streams are relayed as MPEG-TS and played with mpegts.js (Chrome, Edge, Firefox).

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web player is served on

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Keeps the key that seals sign-in cookies, so a restart does not sign everyone out.

Config.Name: DPTV-Server URL
Config.Description: Your DPTV-Server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8000. Leave empty to type it on the sign-in page.

Config.Name: Secure cookie (HTTPS only)
Config.Description: true when the page is only reached over HTTPS, e.g. through a Cloudflare Tunnel.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people open DPTV Web at, e.g. https://dptvweb.example.com. Needed for single sign-on (the provider sends people back to PUBLIC_URL/api/auth/callback).

Config.Name: SSO issuer (Authentik)
Config.Description: Authentik's OpenID Configuration Issuer for this application, e.g. https://auth.example.com/application/o/dptv-web/. Leave empty for no single sign-on.

Config.Name: SSO only
Config.Description: true: no password form, everyone signs in through single sign-on.

Config.Name: Shared DPTV-Server user (SSO)
Config.Description: Optional: an XC login every single-sign-on user uses until they link their own. Leave empty to ask each person for theirs once.

Config.Name: User-Agent
Config.Description: Sent to DPTV-Server and the provider, as DPTV-Player does by default.
